---
title: "Billboard Radio vs. Streaming: Chart Trends"
author: "Ananya Suthram, Brooke Martin, Samantha Oh, Vaishnavi Pavuluri"
date: "2025-12-05"
output: html_document
---

## Research questions

1. Which songs charted for the most weeks?
2. How does artist ranking consistency differ across radio and streaming?
3. Which songs achieved different peak positions on the two charts?
4. Which songs remained in the top 20 during the selected month?

## Data source

[Billboard dataset on Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ludmin/billboard). Place `radio.csv` and `streaming_songs.csv` in the `data/` folder. Run this document from the repository root or adjust the relative paths.

## 1. Data Preparation

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

### 1.1 Import and Clean Radio Data

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
radio <- read_delim("radio.csv") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Radio") %>%
  select(-`Image URL`)
names(radio) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(radio))
head(radio)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
radio <- radio %>%
  mutate(Weeks_in_Charts = ifelse(Weeks_in_Charts == "-", "1",
Weeks_in_Charts))
radio$Weeks_in_Charts <- as.numeric(radio$Weeks_in_Charts)
head(radio)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
radio <- radio %>%
  arrange(Date, Song) %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  mutate(Times_at_1 = cumsum(Rank == 1)) %>%
  arrange(Date, Rank)
head(radio)
```

### 1.2 Import and Clean Streaming Data

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
streaming <- read_delim("streaming_songs.csv") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Streaming") %>%
  select(-`Image URL`)
names(streaming) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(streaming))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
streaming <- streaming %>%
  mutate(Weeks_in_Charts = ifelse(Weeks_in_Charts == "-", "1",
Weeks_in_Charts))

streaming$Weeks_in_Charts <- as.numeric(streaming$Weeks_in_Charts)
head(streaming)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
streaming <- streaming %>%
  arrange(Date, Song) %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  mutate(Times_at_1 = cumsum(Rank == 1)) %>%
  arrange(Date, Rank)
head(streaming)
```

### 1.3 Combine Datasets

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
combined <- merge(radio, streaming, by = intersect(names(radio),
names(streaming)), all = TRUE)
sample_n(combined, 6)
```

## 2. Chart Longevity Analysis

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
radioWeeks <- radio %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  summarize(Weeks_in_Charts = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weeks_in_Charts))

radioWeeks %>%
  head(10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Song, Weeks_in_Charts),
             y = Weeks_in_Charts)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Radio Songs by Number of Charting Weeks",
       x = "Song", y = "Charting Weeks") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
streamingWeeks <- streaming %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  summarize(Weeks_in_Charts = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weeks_in_Charts))

streamingWeeks %>%
  head(10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Song, Weeks_in_Charts),
             y = Weeks_in_Charts)) +
  geom_col(fill = "brown2") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Streaming Songs by # of Charting Weeks",
       x = "Song", y = "Charting Weeks") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
combinedWeeks <- combined %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  summarise(Weeks_in_Charts = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Weeks_in_Charts))

combinedWeeks %>%
  head(10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Song, Weeks_in_Charts),
             y = Weeks_in_Charts)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorchid1") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Songs by Number of Charting Weeks",
       x = "Song", y = "Charting Weeks") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3. Artist Ranking Consistency

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
visual_radio <- combined %>%
  filter(Type == "Radio") %>%
  mutate(
    Maintained_Rank = Rank == Last_Week,
    Increased_Rank = Rank < Last_Week,
    Decreased_Rank = Rank > Last_Week
    ) %>%
  select(Song, Artist, Maintained_Rank, Increased_Rank, Decreased_Rank) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
visual_streaming <- combined %>%
  filter(Type == "Streaming") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rank), !is.na(Last_Week)) %>%
  mutate(
    Maintained_Rank = Rank == Last_Week,
    Increased_Rank = Rank < Last_Week,
    Decreased_Rank = Rank > Last_Week
    ) %>%
  select(Song, Artist, Maintained_Rank, Increased_Rank, Decreased_Rank) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sample_of_15_artists <- visual_streaming %>%
  filter(nchar(Artist) <= 17) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  sample_n(15) %>%
  pull(Artist)

sample_of_15_artists
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
visual_radio %>%
  filter(Artist %in% sample_of_15_artists) %>%
  group_by(Artist) %>%
  summarize(
    Maintained_Rank = sum(Maintained_Rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Increased_Rank = sum(Increased_Rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Decreased_Rank = sum(Decreased_Rank, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Maintained_Rank, Increased_Rank, Decreased_Rank),
    names_to = "Type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Artist, y = Count, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Maintained_Rank" = "cyan2",
      "Increased_Rank" = "chartreuse2",
      "Decreased_Rank" = "deeppink1"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Artist",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Maintained vs Increased Rank in Radio (Sample of 14
Artists)",
    fill = "Rank Change Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust =
1))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
visual_streaming %>%
  filter(Artist %in% sample_of_15_artists) %>%
  group_by(Artist) %>%
  summarize(
    Maintained_Rank = sum(Maintained_Rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Increased_Rank = sum(Increased_Rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Decreased_Rank = sum(Decreased_Rank, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Maintained_Rank, Increased_Rank, Decreased_Rank),
    names_to = "Type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Artist, y = Count, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Maintained_Rank" = "cyan2",
      "Increased_Rank" = "chartreuse2",
      "Decreased_Rank" = "deeppink1"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Artist",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Maintained vs Increased Rank in Streaming (Sample of 14
Artists)",
    fill = "Rank Change Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust =
1))
```

## 4. Peak Rank Position Comparison

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
radio_peaks <- radio %>%
  group_by(Song, Artist) %>%
  summarize(Radio = min(Rank, na.rm = TRUE))

streaming_peaks <- streaming %>%
  group_by(Song, Artist) %>%
  summarize(Streaming = min(Rank, na.rm = TRUE))
peaks <- merge(radio_peaks, streaming_peaks, by = c("Song", "Artist"))

peaks_diff <- peaks %>%
  mutate(Diff = abs(Radio - Streaming)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Diff)) %>%
  head(20)

peaks_long <- peaks_diff %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Radio, Streaming), names_to = "Type", values_to =
"Peak")

plot <- peaks_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Song, y = Peak, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Songs With The Biggest Difference in Peaks", x =
"Song Title", y = "Peak") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust =
1))
plot
```

## 5. Top 20 Chart Performance

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
songsthatlastwholemonth <- combined %>%
  filter(Type=="Streaming") %>%
  filter(between(Date, as.Date("2025-09-22"), as.Date("2025-10-22"))) %>%
  filter(Rank <= 20) %>%
  select(Song, Rank,Date) %>%
  group_by(Song) %>%
  summarise(count=n()) %>%
  filter(count==5) %>%
  pull(Song)
lastday <- combined %>%
  filter(Type=="Streaming") %>%
  filter(Date==as.Date("2025-10-22")) %>%
  filter(Rank <= 20) %>%
  filter(Song %in% songsthatlastwholemonth) %>%
  select(Song, Rank,Date,Weeks_in_Charts)
combined %>%
  filter(Type=="Streaming") %>%
  filter(between(Date, as.Date("2025-09-22"), as.Date("2025-10-22"))) %>%
  filter(Song %in% songsthatlastwholemonth) %>%
  filter(Rank <= 20) %>%
  select(Song, Rank,Date) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Date,y=Rank,col=Song))+
    geom_line()+
  geom_text(data=lastday,aes(label=Song),size=2,col="black")+
  labs(
    title="Streaming songs staying in the top 20 from 2025-09-22 to
2025-10-22"
  )
```

